items.text: Scientists' PT boats can no longer be taken out of the deepsea, matching behavior of other boats.
Scientist boats now only attempt to turn when they have line of sight to the player, reducing erratic movement.
Animals now flee when attacked from a distance and will no longer sleep, fixing previous AI issues.
Sheep feeding bug fixed: they no longer starve despite a trough, and feeding times are synchronized with cows.
AI Sleep Zones are functional again after a race‑condition fix, restoring proper AI sleeping behavior.
Item.UseItem now correctly reports full consumption of an item, and a use‑after‑free bug in Industrial Conveyors has been fixed, improving item handling reliability.
Boat scientist NPCs will now give up chasing a player after a set time and will only pursue up to a maximum distance.
If a boat scientist's main target becomes obstructed, it will swap to another visible target, or bail out if the target stays hidden for long.
When a boat scientist's current target is no longer valid, it will select a new visible player or abort the chase.
If none of the crew on a scientist boat can see the target player, the boat will turn around to face the player before attempting to engage.
Cows can now satisfy their light requirement using lamps.
Fixed Water Purifier incorrectly increasing the garbage stack before removal, preventing inventory clutter.
Research tables now preserve the ItemDef of removed items, eliminating null‑reference crashes during research attempts.
Cookable items now cache necessary data before being destroyed, ensuring cooking tests pass and preventing loss of information.
Expanded the default item pool from 512 to 2,048 slots, with batch removal and loot container resets to reduce overflow issues.
Sprinklers now reliably produce splash effects, maintain a valid fuel type, and stop radwater tint flickering on circuit and output changes.
Radwater splashes now use green effect variants; sprinklers start with proper water, and water‑gun/pistol support with viewmodel integration has been added.
Animal fences and gates can now be placed more easily on sloped terrain.
Fixed an infinite‑power console variable that broke static CCTV cameras, restoring their functionality.
Fixed line-of-sight blocking on ramps, removing the blue LOS indicator that prevented players from seeing the ramp correctly.
Corrected death-screen sleeping-bag button sizing and overlap, preventing misclicks when trying to respawn or interact.
Ensured bags assigned to a dead player appear on the map immediately, fixing the issue where bags were invisible after death or after rejoining.
Adjusted random gutting bonuses for catfish, orange roughy, salmon, and small sharks: the 20% chance now yields a blueprint fragment instead of 8 cloth.
Added blueprint fragments and blueprint pages to underwater crates, aligning their loot pool with other crate types.
AI Sleep Zones now work correctly, restoring proper AI sleeping behavior.

Boat scientist AI now only attempts turns when the player is visible, switches targets if the current one is obstructed, rotates to face players when unseen, and gives up chasing after a maximum distance or time or when shot.
Sheep feeding bug fixed so they no longer starve at troughs, and cows can satisfy their light requirement using lamps.
Cows no longer clip through walls when lying down, and animal fences and gates can now be placed more easily on sloped terrain.
Water Purifier no longer incorrectly increases the garbage stack before removal, preventing inventory overflow.
Default item pool size increased from 512 to 2,048 to stop overflow issues.

Gutting bonuses for catfish, orange roughy, salmon, and small shark adjusted; 20% chance to get 8 cloth replaced with 20% chance to get a blueprint fragment, and blueprint fragments/pages added to underwater crates.
Fixed sprinklers skipping splash effects, temporary null fuel type, and radwater tint flicker on circuit/output changes; sprinklers now start with proper water.
Radwater splashes now use green effect variants; added support for water gun and water pistol with viewmodel integration.

2026-10-26.summary:
### AI & NPC Behavior
- AI Sleep Zones now work correctly, restoring proper AI sleeping behavior.
- Boat scientist AI now only attempts turns when the player is visible, switches targets if the current one is obstructed, rotates to face players when unseen, and gives up chasing after a maximum distance or time or when shot.

### Livestock & Farming
- Sheep feeding bug fixed so they no longer starve at troughs, and cows can satisfy their light requirement using lamps.
- Cows no longer clip through walls when lying down, and animal fences and gates can now be placed more easily on sloped terrain.

### Item & Crafting
- Water Purifier no longer incorrectly increases the garbage stack before removal, preventing inventory overflow.

### Loot & Item Pool
- Default item pool size increased from 512 to 2,048 to stop overflow issues.
- Gutting bonuses for catfish, orange roughy, salmon, and small shark adjusted; 20% chance to get 8 cloth replaced with 20% chance to get a blueprint fragment, and blueprint fragments/pages added to underwater crates.

### Sprinklers & Radwater
- Fixed sprinklers skipping splash effects, temporary null fuel type, and radwater tint flicker on circuit/output changes; sprinklers now start with proper water.
- Radwater splashes now use green effect variants; added support for water gun and water pistol with viewmodel integration.

items.text: Animal repellant buff now only affects sharks (they flee) and bee swarms (they won't chase); bulls and rams ignore the buff and will neither flee nor charge.
Chickens on the tutorial island no longer act aggressively.
Sunflower seed-stage plants can now be cleared reliably with a melee weapon.
Child livestock can leave their mother's leash radius to eat from a trough, preventing them from getting stuck hungry in pens.
Building planner now shows the specific blocker name instead of a generic "Cannot build in this area" message.
Ramp placement improved: aiming at the center of a foundation now places ramps correctly.
Wrapping paper can no longer be filled with water, preventing unintended item behavior.

2026-10-25.summary:
### Animals & AI
- Animal repellant buff now only affects sharks (they flee) and bee swarms (they won't chase); bulls and rams ignore the buff and will neither flee nor charge.
- Chickens on the tutorial island no longer act aggressively.

### Farming
- Sunflower seed-stage plants can now be cleared reliably with a melee weapon.
- Child livestock can leave their mother's leash radius to eat from a trough, preventing them from getting stuck hungry in pens.

### Building & UI
- Building planner now shows the specific blocker name instead of a generic "Cannot build in this area" message.
- Ramp placement improved: aiming at the center of a foundation now places ramps correctly.

### Bug Fixes
- Wrapping paper can no longer be filled with water, preventing unintended item behavior.

items.text: Shears now harvest 25% more wool, have double durability (200), and deal reduced damage (4 slash + 4 stab), making them a more efficient wool‑gathering tool.
Network packet batching reduces latency and improves responsiveness; can be toggled at runtime.
Fixed viewmodel camera bone positioning, correcting misaligned weapon view.
